The Harbour Light, a short scene in plain text.

MARA: I kept the light on. Every night.
Tomas (calling up): Mara? Is that you up there?
MARA: [dry] Who else would be fool enough to climb these stairs in this weather?
TOMAS: I came as soon as the boat was in. The harbour master says the storm turns at midnight.

(They watch the water.)

Mara: Then we wait.
Tomas:
Radio operator: (crackling) Lighthouse, this is the Saint Brigid. Do you read?
MARA: I read you, Saint Brigid. Keep to the light.
